title: Detroit's school music system and Cass Tech
summary: Cass Tech's training counted as junior college; he passed its aptitude test but explains later why he left.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: School days: grades, teachers and leaving school

blocks.x: Detroit has turned out so many excellent musicians, you know, because they had a great music system in the school

system. In fact, Cass Tech there in Detroit, if you came out of there you were considered equivalent to a two-year-college...a junior college education in your specialty, because you could really specialize in whatever you were doing. I passed the aptitude test there. I went there later for a while. But I'll explain later why I left. I had to give it up, you know.
No, not her this time! It wasn't her. It was me this time. But I'll get around to that. But it was really, really great times in Detroit during that period.
